proposed.source: Task source addyosmani-agent-skills: a recursive tree of the default-branch HEAD, filtered by keyword, then the SKILL.md was read through the GitHub GraphQL API (git blob oid verified).
proposed.demonstrated_gap: Complement for the 'before writing code' half of the requirement. Neither installed skill requires that a chosen component's API be checked against version-matched official sources before code is written: search-first stops at Adopt, Extend or Build, and iterative-retrieval only ranks local files. source-driven-development does five things. (1) It detects exact versions from the dependency file. (2) It fetches official docs, then official blog or changelog, ranked by authority, and excludes Stack Overflow, blogs and training data. (3) It treats fetched pages as untrusted data ('Retrieval Safety'). (4) It cites a full URL for every framework-specific decision. (5) It marks the rest UNVERIFIED, with a verification checklist. This closely follows this repository's capability-check order (installed client, then changelog for that version, then upstream source at the tag, then official docs). It omits the installed-client --help and source-at-tag steps, which the trial should score. Caveat, not a conflict: it asks the user only when versions remain missing or ambiguous after it reads the dependency file (L61), so it imposes no mandatory intake. Its broad trigger ('any framework or library where correctness matters') may add tokens to ordinary coding turns, which the decision rule prices in. Last changed 2026-09-07 (cda4542a), at the edge of the 4-week window.
